How to begin

Different starting paths. A clear next step.

01

Individual care

Start directly with a diagnostic evaluation (90791), or choose an optional free 10-minute phone consultation or paid 30-minute individual consultation first.

See the individual journey →
02

Couples care

Begin with a required 30-minute couples consultation, followed by one separate diagnostic evaluation per partner, then return together for 53-minute couples sessions.

See the couples journey →
03

Your 10-minute consultation

An optional phone introduction for individuals and couples. If an arranged video connection does not work immediately, it becomes a phone call. The caller may show the practice name or a hidden number.

Know what to expect →

Common questions

Answers before you schedule.

Do I have to have a consultation before individual therapy?

No. Individuals can go directly to the diagnostic evaluation (90791). The free 10-minute phone consultation and paid 30-minute individual consultation are optional. Compare your starting options.

What is the first appointment for couples?

All couples start with a paid 30-minute couples consultation to align goals and the rhythm of care. An optional 10-minute phone call may come first, but does not replace it. Each partner then has one separate diagnostic evaluation with the couples therapist before joint 53-minute couples sessions. Read the couples journey.

Do you offer online therapy?

Yes. Secure telehealth may be available to eligible clients who are physically located in Washington at the time of care.

How do I check insurance benefits?

Email support@mft.care to start a benefits-verification request. Coverage depends on the clinician, service, plan, and network status.

Still unsure? Ask our support team a question.
